title: QA Engineer-Automation & Performance
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior QA Automation \& Performance Engineer
 
  
 


 DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES
 
 • Lead quality assurance processes, functional automation, and performance testing across distributed application teams.
 



 • Own, design, and maintain automated test frameworks for web applications and RESTful services.
 



 • Implement automated performance, load, and stress testing for APIs to identify system bottlenecks before deployment.
 



 • Integrate automated E2E and performance test suites directly into Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using GitHub Actions.
 



 • Collaborate with distributed software development teams to set and enforce quality gate standards.
 



 • Manage test scenarios, scripts, and code using Git source control and Jira project management.
 



 • Operate with high autonomy as the primary quality owner, driving testing initiatives with minimal supervision.
 



  
 


 QUALIFICATION
 
 • Strong understanding of core QA methodologies, test automation patterns, and Continuous Delivery concepts
 



 • Deep understanding of Web\-based architecture, and RESTful APIs
 



 • Hands\-on experience with modern web automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium).
 



 • Proficiency in at least one primary programming language used for test automation (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#, or Java).
 



  
 


 EXPERIENCE
 
 • Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience in software quality assurance and test automation.
 



 • Proven experience in designing and executing performance, load, and stress testing using tools such as k6, or JMeter.
 



 • Experience setting up, executing, and maintaining automated test suites within GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD pipelines.
 



 • Experience testing modern web application architectures (SPAs, microservices, containerized environments).
 



 • Hands\-on experience working in cloud environments (Azure platform preferred).
 



  
 


 KNOWLEDGE
 
 • Deep knowledge of defining comprehensive test cases and edge cases with minimal supervision.
 



 • Knowledge of performance metrics (latency, response time, throughput, error rates) and establishing failure thresholds in CI pipelines.
 



 • Ability to analyze root causes of bugs, document detailed findings, and provide actionable engineering recommendations to improve system reliability.
 



  
 


 PEOPLE \& OTHER SKILLS
 
 • Strong interpersonal and written communication skills to articulate defects and performance risks to developers and stakeholders.
 



 • Exceptional self\-motivation, ownership mindset, and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  
 


 EDUCATION
 
 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
